hooks.command: out=$(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/check-staleness.py" 2>&1 || true); sum=$(printf "%s" "$out" | grep -E "^(STALE VALUES STILL LIVE|BOM INTEGRITY|PASS|FAIL)" | tr "\n" " "); jq -n --arg s "staleness check - $sum" --arg o "$out" '{systemMessage: $s, hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", additionalContext:$o}}'
